description: Approved breaking changes to the OpenAPI contract. Each entry records a reviewed decision to accept a breaking change, with justification and migration notes for clients.

approvedChanges.migrationNotes: Clients should migrate to /v1/resources. The new endpoint provides the same functionality with improved performance. Transition timeline: deprecated v0.1.x endpoints will be removed in v1.0.0.
approvedChanges.reason: Cleanup of deprecated API surface before 1.0.0 release. Migration path is clear and documented.

policyNotes.description: Guidelines for recording approved breaking changes
rules: Every breaking change must have an entry in this file with changeId, description, apiVersion, migrationNotes, approvedAt, and reason
apiVersion must be higher than the baseline version when approving the change
migrationNotes must be non-empty and provide clear guidance for API consumers
approvedAt should be an ISO 8601 timestamp when the decision was made
reason should explain why the breaking change was necessary and how it benefits the API
Unapproved breaking changes will fail the OpenAPI breaking-change gate in CI
